ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
geotiff:
- '1.7'
gflags:
- '2.3'
glog:
- '0.7'
hdf5:
- 1.14.6
- '2'
libblas:
- 3.9.* *netlib
libcblas:
- 3.9.* *netlib
libcurl:
- '8'
libgdal_core:
- '3.13'
libpq:
- '18'
libxml2_devel:
- '2.15'
openssl:
- '3.5'
proj:
- '9.9'
target_platform:
- linux-64
tiledb:
- '2.30'
xerces_c:
- '3.3'
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
zlib:
- '1'
zstd:
- '1.5'
name: libpdal-core
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.10.2"

recipe:
  name: libpdal-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/PDAL/PDAL/releases/download/${{ version }}/PDAL-${{ version }}-src.tar.bz2
  sha256: 882b97aa3ae5db682c3b2dc8edef4e29bcc7ecea51c70592e71bc1f34112ad00

build:
  number: 9
  dynamic_linking:
    overlinking_behavior: ${{ "error" if unix else "ignore" }}
    overdepending_behavior: ${{ "error" if unix else "ignore" }}

outputs:
  - package:
      name: libpdal-core
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overlinking_behavior: ${{ "error" if unix else "ignore" }}
        overdepending_behavior: ${{ "error" if unix else "ignore" }}
        # rattler-build 0.80.2 excludes symlinks from its own-package check.
        # This SONAME is shipped by this output, and tested below.
        missing_dso_allowlist:
          - if: linux
            then: lib/libpdalcpp.so.20
      script:
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/build.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\build.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - if: unix
          then:
            - pkgconf
      host:
        - libgdal-core
        - geotiff
        - libcurl
        - openssl
        - zlib
        - libxml2-devel
        - proj
      run:
        # Help the solver pick an icu-compatible libxml2; libgdal-core depends
        # on xerces-c, which pulls in icu on unix.
        - if: unix
          then: icu *
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - echo "Testing for header"
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/include/pdal/pdal.hpp
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_INC%\pdal\pdal.hpp exit 1
            - echo "Testing for library"
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdalcpp${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\pdalcpp.dll exit 1
            - if: linux
              then:
                - test -L ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdalcpp.so.20
                - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdalcpp.so.20
            - echo "Testing for CLI"
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/bin/pdal
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\pdal.exe exit 1
            - pdal --version
            - pdal --drivers --debug

  - package:
      name: libpdal
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-trajectory', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-hdf', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-tiledb', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-pgpointcloud', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-draco', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-arrow', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-nitf', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-e57', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-icebridge', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - if: not win
          then: ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-cpd', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-trajectory', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-hdf', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-tiledb', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-pgpointcloud', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-draco', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-arrow', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-nitf', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-e57', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-icebridge', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - if: not win
          then: ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-cpd', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - echo "tested in other outputs"

  - package:
      name: libpdal-trajectory
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: trajectory
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\install_pdal_plugin.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
        - ceres-solver
        - glog
        - gflags
        - if: unix
          then:
            - libblas
            - libcblas
        - if: win
          then: mkl-devel
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-trajectory', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          # Intel macOS emits direct glog calls from Ceres/Eigen headers.
          # Linux and Apple Silicon only need glog through Ceres.
          - if: linux or target_platform == "osx-arm64"
            then: glog
          - if: unix
            then: gflags
          - libblas
          - libcblas
          - if: win
            then: mkl-devel
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_filter_trajectory${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_filter_trajectory.dll exit 1
            - if: unix
              then: pdal --options filters.trajectory | grep -F "filters.trajectory --"
              else: pdal --options filters.trajectory | findstr /C:"filters.trajectory --"
    about:
      summary: PDAL trajectory filter
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: LICENSE.txt

  - package:
      name: libpdal-hdf
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: hdf
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\install_pdal_plugin.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - hdf5
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-icebridge', exact=True) }}
        - libgdal-hdf5
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-hdf', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_reader_hdf${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_reader_hdf.dll exit 1
            - if: unix
              then: pdal --options readers.hdf | grep -F "readers.hdf --"
              else: pdal --options readers.hdf | findstr /C:"readers.hdf --"
    about:
      summary: Point Data Abstraction Library (PDAL)
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: LICENSE.txt

  - package:
      name: libpdal-draco
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: draco
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\install_pdal_plugin.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - draco
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_compatible('draco', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-draco', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then:
                - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_writer_draco${SHLIB_EXT}
                - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_reader_draco${SHLIB_EXT}
              else:
                - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_writer_draco.dll exit 1
                - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_reader_draco.dll exit 1
            - if: unix
              then: pdal --options readers.draco | grep -F "readers.draco --"
              else: pdal --options readers.draco | findstr /C:"readers.draco --"
            - if: unix
              then: pdal --options writers.draco | grep -F "writers.draco --"
              else: pdal --options writers.draco | findstr /C:"writers.draco --"
    about:
      summary: Point Data Abstraction Library (PDAL)
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: LICENSE.txt

  - package:
      name: libpdal-e57
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: e57
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\install_pdal_plugin.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
        - xerces-c
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-e57', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then:
                - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_writer_e57${SHLIB_EXT}
                - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_reader_e57${SHLIB_EXT}
              else:
                - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_writer_e57.dll exit 1
                - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_reader_e57.dll exit 1
            - if: unix
              then: pdal --options readers.e57 | grep -F "readers.e57 --"
              else: pdal --options readers.e57 | findstr /C:"readers.e57 --"
            - if: unix
              then: pdal --options writers.e57 | grep -F "writers.e57 --"
              else: pdal --options writers.e57 | findstr /C:"writers.e57 --"

  - package:
      name: libpdal-icebridge
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: icebridge
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh

    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
        - hdf5
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-icebridge', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_reader_icebridge${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_reader_icebridge.dll exit 1
            - if: unix
              then: pdal --options readers.icebridge | grep -F "readers.icebridge --"
              else: pdal --options readers.icebridge | findstr /C:"readers.icebridge --"

  - package:
      name: libpdal-tiledb
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: tiledb
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh

      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - tiledb
        - if: unix
          then: icu *
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
        - libgdal-tiledb
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-tiledb', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - if: unix
            then: icu
    tests:

          content:
            - if: unix
              then:
                - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_writer_tiledb${SHLIB_EXT}
                - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_reader_tiledb${SHLIB_EXT}
              else:
                - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_writer_tiledb.dll exit 1
                - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_reader_tiledb.dll exit 1
            - if: unix

              else: pdal --options readers.tiledb | findstr /C:"readers.tiledb --"
            - if: unix
              then: pdal --options writers.tiledb | grep -F "writers.tiledb --"
              else: pdal --options writers.tiledb | findstr /C:"writers.tiledb --"
    about:
      summary: Point Data Abstraction Library (PDAL)
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: LICENSE.txt

  - package:
      name: libpdal-pgpointcloud
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: pgpointcloud
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\install_pdal_plugin.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - libpq
        - libxml2-devel
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run:

              else: pdal --options writers.pgpointcloud | findstr /C:"writers.pgpointcloud --"

        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:

        - libparquet

        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run:

        - ${{ compiler('c') }}

        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}

    tests:

        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: cpd
        content:
          - bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh

        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - eigen
      host:
        - cpd
        - fgt
        - icu *
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_compatible('cpd', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('fgt', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-cpd', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
      ignore_run_exports:

      summary: Point Data Abstraction Library (PDAL)
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: LICENSE.txt

about:
  homepage: https://www.pdal.io
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Point Data Abstraction Library (PDAL)
  description: Point cloud data processing.
  documentation: https://pdal.io
  repository: https://github.com/pdal/pdal

extra:
  feedstock-name: libpdal
  recipe-maintainers:
    - chambbj
    - hobu
